facts.fact: INSTAT's Enquete Modulaire et Permanente aupres des Menages (EMOP) annual report 2025 gives SDG 5.b.1, the proportion of the population owning a mobile phone, as 88.1% for the whole country (89.0% men, 78.5% women); the excerpt states no age range, and its text describes the same 88.1% as household ownership.

systems.country_label: 88.1% of households own a mobile phone, 2025 (66.7% in 2011)
